thread:
Asha (CS): Quick thread — we observed sustained auth latency spikes affecting a subset of onboarding tenants (approx 14 accounts, mostly EMEA). Need customer comms + office hours invite. Marcus, what’s the current mitigation status?

Marcus (Eng Oncall): Mitigation in progress — rolling a config tweak to auth proxy to reduce token validation retries. Deployed to canary 10m ago, seeing 60% reduction in p95 on canary. Still validating behavior on EU regions.

Asha (CS): Thanks. We should send an acknowledgement to affected tenants now with a short ETA and offer office hours. Draft below — please edit.

Priya (CS Ops): Drop my edits inline. Keep it brief and transparent; include expected time-window and how we’ll follow up. Also include credit offer for high-touch onboarding customers.

Asha (CS): DRAFT MESSAGE to customers: 

"Hi <CustomerName> — we’ve detected intermittent auth latency impacting some onboarding flows in EU. We’re actively mitigating and have a rollback/patch underway. You may see slower sign-in or provisioning delays for up to 2 hours. We’ll run a dedicated office hours session at 14:00 UTC for affected teams. If you’re seeing issues, reply to this thread or join the office hours link below. We apologize for the disruption and will share an RCA after we stabilize. — Asha, Customer Success"

Julian (SE): Suggest adding a concise troubleshooting step they can try (refresh token or restart local client) + link to status page.

Asha (CS): Updated DRAFT (v2): 

"Hi <CustomerName> — we’ve detected intermittent auth latency impacting some onboarding flows in EU. We’re actively mitigating (patch rolling now). Symptoms: slower sign-in or provisioning delays. Quick try: please retry the operation once or restart the client; this often bypasses transient auth retries. We expect stabilization within ~2 hours and will notify you when complete. Office hours: 14:00 UTC (link). If you need immediate help, reply here and we’ll prioritize. We apologize for the disruption — Asha, CS"

Priya (CS Ops): +1. Recommend we segment outbound: (1) high-touch enterprise customers get a personalized note + phone outreach, (2) SMB/onboarding customers get the broadcast email and office hours invite. I’ll prepare recipient lists.

Raj (Product): For the RCA, please capture: root cause (token cache invalidation during backend configuration change), trigger timeline, impacting regions/accounts, mitigation steps, and next prevention steps (toggle + safer rollout gating).

Marcus (Eng Oncall): Confirming root cause hypothesis: config change to auth-cache TTL caused cache churn under load in EU proxies resulting in repeated validation calls to KMS. We’ll include logs and metric spikes in RCA. Post-mitigation action: revert TTL change, add canary gating + an alert on auth-retry rate.

Incident Bot: Incident #INC-2026-042 — status: mitigated on canary, in-progress for EU rollout. Pager duty: @marcus.

Asha (CS): Action items: 
- Priya: assemble recipients and send broadcast within 15m (include office hours link + quick retry step).
- Julian: paste the short troubleshooting snippet and status page link into the final message.
- Marcus: confirm when EU rollout hit 100% and share final metrics.
- Raj: add RCA skeleton to shared drive; CS will add customer-facing summary.

Priya (CS Ops): On it — sending segmented broadcast in ~12m. For enterprise cohort I’ll do a follow-up call schedule and include the goodwill credit template we’ve used before.

Julian (SE): Status page link: https://status.redwood.example/incident/INC-2026-042 — include that in the final message. Troubleshoot snippet (one-liner): `If you see a failed auth, please retry once and report back; persistent issues: collect timestamp + request id and share with support.`

Asha (CS): Final check — do we want legal/comm review? Message keeps no technical detail beyond symptom/ETA. I think ok for broadcast. Raj?

Raj (Product): No legal needed for this short acknowledgment. If we issue credits or more detailed RCA that references internal config names, run it by security/product.

Marcus (Eng Oncall): EU rollout complete at +28m from canary. p95 latency back to normal on all nodes. I’ll post the post-mitigation metric set in the RCA doc.

Asha (CS): Perfect — Priya, send broadcast and tag affected enterprises for follow-up calls. I’ll host office hours. We’ll post RCA draft within 24h and customer-facing summary within 48h.

Priya (CS Ops): Broadcast sent to segment A (SMB/onboarders) at 6492001300. Enterprise invites queued; I’ll start calls in 10m.

Asha (CS): Thanks team. Capture feedback from office hours and we’ll include quotes for the exec summary. :thumbsup:
